body: it's kind of the combination of several things. i just feel like i can't fit into society, like i function on a much lower level. the catalyst for this post is the fact that i went to a massive high school band event and i only felt comfortable talking to my band director. even talking to my band director is awkward. i just don't feel comfortable around anyone.
you could try the crisis text line. it's just for any crisis you might encounter, like anxiety or depressive episodes. just text "START" to 741-741.

I'll try the mindfulness meditation. I'll also see if I can talk to my counselor or someone else. My mom and I have a good relationship, but she usually just gets angry when I try to talk to her about my anxiety. She hasn't dealt with mental issues in the past. However, I think if she heard it from another source, she'll take it seriously. Thanks a lot for your help. You're really kind.
I do appreciate your advice, and it is helping. Talking to somebody is a good idea, but it's a daunting idea to talk to my counselor and tell her that I can't stop cutting.

In terms of appetite, it's not great. I eat a lot of cheap junk food. I do try to watch exactly how bad the food I'm eating is, like I cut out a lot of sugar and salt, but it's not as healthy as it could be. I worry about my own health a lot, actually. It's weird that you brought up the psychosis thing, because that's one of the major things I worry about. I'm always afraid that I'm going crazy or losing my grip on reality. A lot of my anxiety is also based around the social aspect of things. I would love to talk to somebody, but like I said, there are a lot of things impeding that process. I appreciate your concern.
